description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'Permission' that provides permission-based access control for views, including methods for route alteration, cache management, and permission handling.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that manages permission-based access control for views, including route alteration and cache management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the permission handler and module extension list, with deprecation warning for certain argument types.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the given user account has the required permission.

methods.name: alterRouteDefinition
methods.description: Modifies the route to include the required permission requirement.

methods.name: summaryTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the permission for display purposes.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the plugin, including the default permission.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for selecting permissions in the plugin configuration.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the cache max age, set to permanent.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts related to user permissions.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags, empty in this implementation.
